text:
alex: CI microbench failure on PR #10500 — threshold diff for batcher prefetch window. p99 tail up ~12%, throughput down ~3%. Job: ci/microbench/batcher/seqlen.
ci-bot: :warning: Perf job 982 failed — https://ci.redwood/982 (artifacts attached)
marie: repro'd locally with the PR image. toggling prefetch_window shows a clear delta.
marie: ```
old (prefetch=16): p99=32.1ms, tokens/s=12.4k
new (prefetch=48): p99=36.0ms, tokens/s=12.0k
delta: +12% p99, -3.2% throughput
```
devon: bisect points at commit abc123 (prefetch scheduler rewrite) from PR 10495. change adjusts lookahead heuristics and max window.
alex: interestingly KV cache hit rate drops ~6% in the failing traces — could be prefetch causing eviction churn. profile snapshot attached.
sam: two quick experiments: 1) revert the prefetch rewrite 2) limit prefetch cap to 24. which is cheaper to test?
perfbot: queued jobs: #983 (revert-candidate), #984 (cap-24-candidate). estimated runtime ~12m each.
marie: ran cap-24 locally -> p99 only +3% vs baseline. revert fully restores baseline numbers.
devon: also try forcing old kernel selection to rule out any kernel selector interaction: `--force-kernel=kernel_v2` during run.
alex: created branch `bisect/revert-prefetch-3129999999` and opened PR for revert. tagging as rollout-blocker for #10500. link: https://git.redwood/revert-prefetch-3129999999
ci-bot: re-run started for #983 (revert branch).
sam: +1 on revert if CI confirms. also add a regression test that exercises kv-cache + prefetch interplay to prevent future regressions.
marie: assigning follow-up to devon to add instrumentation for kv eviction counters and an integration test.
devon: will add counters and an integration harness that simulates mixed short/long context sequences to catch eviction thrash.
ci-bot: job 983 passed on revert branch (green). job 984 (cap-24) still running.
marie: cap-24 looks like a lower-risk mitigation if we want a smaller change while we design a proper fix.
alex: thanks all — holding merge on #10500 until we decide. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: archival note: attaching perf diffs and flamegraphs to the revert PR artifacts.
